ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a fused bicyclic structure, with one six-membered ring on the left side and one on the right side, and the two rings share one edge; in the six-membered ring on the right side there is an atom labeled N. The right ring connects to the right to a central carbon, and the central carbon then connects respectively to the O on the right side, the O in the lower-left OH, and the N in the lower NH2. The figure also shows curved arrows and hydrogens connected to O/N. Reasoning: According to the specified method, count only unique non-hydrogen bonds, and ignore arrows. The fused bicyclic system is counted as two six-membered rings sharing one edge: the left ring has 6 bonds, and the right ring adds 5 new bonds after removing the shared edge, so there are 11 intra-ring heavy-atom bonds in total. The exocyclic group has 4 non-hydrogen bonds: ring to central carbon, central carbon to right-side O, central carbon to lower-left OH oxygen, and central carbon to NH2 nitrogen. After excluding O-H and N-H bonds, the total is 11 + 4 = 15.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Trace and count unique non-H bonds directly from the drawing. Count the fused bicyclic ring as two six-membered rings sharing one edge: 6 bonds in the left ring plus 5 additional bonds in the right ring = 11 heavy-atom ring bonds. Then count the side-group bonds shown outside the ring: ring-to-central carbon, central carbon-to-right O, central carbon-to-left OH oxygen, and central carbon-to-NH2 nitrogen = 4 more. Exclude O-H and N-H bonds and disregard arrows. Sum 11 + 4 = 15.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中显示一个融合的双环结构，左侧和右侧各是一个六元环，并且两环共用一条边；右侧六元环中有一个标为 N 的原子。右侧环向右连接到一个中心碳，中心碳再分别连接到右侧的 O、左下方 OH 中的 O、以及下方 NH2 中的 N。图中还画有弯曲箭头以及与 O/N 相连的氢。推理：按指定方法只计数唯一的非氢键，并忽略箭头。融合双环按两个六元环共用一条边计数：左环有 6 条键，右环除去共用边后新增 5 条键，所以环内重原子键共有 11 条。环外侧基有 4 条非氢键：环到中心碳、中心碳到右侧 O、中心碳到左下 OH 氧、中心碳到 NH2 氮。排除 O-H 和 N-H 键后，总数为 11 + 4 = 15。

method.method_draft: Convert the image into a heavy-atom graph. Count heavy atoms: the fused quinoline-like ring has 10 heavy atoms, and the attached tetrahedral center with OH, O, and NH2 contributes 4 more heavy atoms, for V = 14. The graph is connected and has two independent cycles from the fused bicyclic ring system, with no additional side-chain cycles. Therefore heavy-atom bonds E = V + cycles - 1 = 14 + 2 - 1 = 15. This automatically excludes O-H/N-H bonds and ignores arrows.
